title: Iran Conditionally Offers Nuclear Inspector Access If Sanctions Eased
detail: Iran conditionally offered to allow nuclear inspectors access to its facilities if Western sanctions are eased — a significant diplomatic overture amid the ongoing conflict and sanctions regime. The proposal comes after the IAEA Board of Governors voted in September to refer Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council following over a year without inspector access.

media.caption: Iran conditionally offers to allow nuclear inspectors if Western sanctions are eased
